notes: Random object record (kind 16, 8 or random; speed at, near or away from a random hover minimum; heading -7..7, pitch -1.7..1.7), a waypoint table entry near or far from the object (sometimes with a zero x offset), random map scale, near distance, lookahead, cell scale, terrain clearance, minimum error, pitch rate and scale. The real fcos/fsin, truncate, square, sqrt and atan2 helpers run; the 0x7b16c terrain stub logs EAX/EDX/EBX and returns a random height.
